kind: next-message probe (development diagnostic): one model call per run, the reply recorded and classified, never executed
question: After the harness holds a transfer, does the feedback text decide whether gpt-5-mini tells the customer a transfer is under way when none was made? v1's text (what the model received) against harness v3.1's text (what H008 would show), at the same saved points.
why: research/v3_1/held_transfers.json: in 9 of 9 saved histories where v1 held a transfer, the agent's next message told the customer a transfer was under way, none was executed, and no tool was called afterwards. v3.1's feedback says the call was NOT executed and that a repeat will be. H008 ($9.00) depends on this working on its 3 transfer tasks.

arms.A_v1_text: the feedback the model actually received, read byte for byte from the saved history
arms.B_v3_1_text: the feedback harness v3.1 gives at the same point (bench/harness.py gate_search_before_giving_up, capability advice on as in H008), computed from the same evidence

arm_design: The arms differ only in the text of the tool result for the held transfer call. History, system prompt (tau2's, unmodified policy), tool list (the benchmark's tools plus those the adapter had offered by then), model and reasoning setting are the original run's. B's text also carries v3's capability-wording advice line, because that is the text H008 would show; the probe tests H008's text, not the framing alone.
reconstruction_checks: bench/hold_probe.py preflight, before any call, for every case: v1's feedback recomputed from the saved history equals the text the model received; the tools offered then are a subset of those offered at the end of the run; the held call's result is marked as an error. Any failure stops the run with nothing sent.

settings.note: H004's agent settings. No seed (OpenAI does not take one here); samples are independent draws.

run_order: cases in plan order; for each case, 3 samples; within a sample the two arms back to back, the first arm alternating with (case index + sample) parity

outcomes.labels: automatic and pre-registered (bench/hold_probe.py classify), for the reply as generated: transfer_again (it calls transfer_to_human_agents), retrieval (a knowledge-base search or shell call, no transfer), other_tool, claims_transfer (text only, and it says a transfer or escalation is happening or done), other_text
secondary: retrieval or other tool call rate per arm
per case: claims_transfer in A and in B
outcomes.reading: Every reply is also read, blind to arm (research/d004/blind.py writes the replies shuffled, without arm), and labelled with the same five labels before unblinding. Disagreements with the automatic label are reported; the automatic label stays primary.

decision_rule: Fixed before the run. v3.1's text goes to H008 unchanged if B's claims_transfer rate is at most 1/3 AND at most half of A's. Otherwise the text is revised, the revision is described, and a new probe plan is frozen before H008. transfer_again is not scored as good or bad here: on these pilot tasks a transfer was mostly the wrong outcome; the question is only whether the agent stops claiming one that did not happen.
limits: 9 cases, all from H004 (bm25 retrieval, harness v1 or v1 + dependency search), on pilot tasks; chosen after observing the failure: a development diagnostic of one mechanism, not a pass-rate estimate
one step only: what the agent does next, not how the conversation ends
the model's reply is not executed and no customer answers it

cost_forecast.basis: 54 calls. Inputs are the saved histories, about 13k to 75k tokens (the longest carries dependency-search documents). gpt-5-mini $0.25 input, $0.025 cached input, $2.00 output per million. Repeated samples of a case share the prefix, so most input is cached.
cost_forecast.reservation: each call reserves its input bound at the full price plus 16,384 output tokens: up to about $0.13 for the longest case

budget_handling: enforced on the BILLED figure (bench/budget.py); the upper bound is reported too. A run the allocation cannot fund is not_run, never replaced.
no_retries: no run is repeated, whatever its outcome
approval: runs only after Nidhi approves in chat with the amount: 'run D004 with $1.00'
command: uv run --extra bench python -m bench.hold_probe experiments/D004_plan.json --approved-usd 1.0
